comments.value:
Even when there was confirmation, it's the same confirmation as everything else so it's dialog fatigue and muscle memory. Unfriending someone is the same amount of clicks as joining them, and because the buttons were so close together, it was easy to unfriend someone when you meant to join them. 

When fixing this, please add a second dialog "Are you absolutely sure?"

Absolutely needs to be _at least_ two clicks, maybe with a 5 second delay on the "accept" button. Runescape has that for deleting stacks of items and it works great for making sure you want to do that. I sure as heck want that for my friends. I'd be utterly devastated if I accidentally removed a friend and somehow couldn't find them again.
There's a confirmation step before unfriending now, so a misclick next to "favorite friend" won't quietly drop someone off your list.

details: There is no confirmation prompt if you unfriend someone, and with its placement in the redesigned profile being underneath `favorite friend`in the dropdown, it is entirely possible to misclick and unfriend someone by accident.
title: No Confirmation Prompt For Unfriending
